name: Google Chrome
detail: Pages, images and scripts Chrome keeps to load sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and open tabs are somewhere else and are untouched.

name: Safari
detail: Safari's page cache. Rebuilt as you browse, and separate from your history and saved passwords.

name: Firefox
detail: Firefox's page and script cache. Rebuilt as you browse; profiles, bookmarks and logins live elsewhere.

name: Microsoft Edge
detail: Edge's page cache. Rebuilt as you browse, and separate from your profile data.

name: Brave
detail: Brave's page cache. Rebuilt as you browse, and separate from your profile data.

name: Arc
detail: Arc's page cache. Rebuilt as you browse, and separate from your spaces and tabs.
